test_title: PYST 4: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 28 Jul, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Fill in the blank with most appropriate option:

The manager wants the report ___ by tomorrow morning.
solution:
The correct answer is '**submitted**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence follows the grammatical structure: **Subject + Verb (want/need/get) + Object + Past Participle**.
 
• This structure is used when we want to say that we would like something to be done by someone else. The object (the report) receives the action.
 
• The **past participle** ("**submitted**") acts as an object complement, describing the required state of the report.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"The manager wants the report **submitted**__ by tomorrow morning."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "submit"** is the base form of the verb. While you could say "The manager wants him **to submit** the report," you cannot use the base form directly after the object "report."
 
• **Option 2: "submitting"** is the present participle. Using it here would imply the report is the one performing the action of submitting, which is incorrect.
 
• **Option 4: "submits"** is the third-person singular present form. It cannot function as a complement to the object in this sentence structure.
